intent: Probe an external agent: declare an execution policy (allow exec, host allow-list, timeout, output cap) and two agent capabilities (HTTP and stdio) in the Background, then a single decision node asks whether to route to the local engine or forward to the external agent, and on the agent route calls the app_server capability passing the state text and projecting the agent's output.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 5 iterations
a choice question "route" asks "Should this request be handled by the local engine, or forwarded to the external agent?"

unknown_steps.text: a routing question "route" asks "Should this go to the agent?"
